headline: Nigerian Local Governments Receive N4.3 Trillion from Federation Account
summary: Nigeria's 774 local governments received a total net allocation of N4.3 trillion from the Federation Account between January and August 2026.
why: Federation account allocations represent the primary revenue source for sub-national governments in Nigeria, funding local infrastructure, public sector payrolls, and public services.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Large public revenue transfers impact subnational government spending and economic activity.
